subject: ci: pass solution dir to portable project build
body: ci: pass solution dir to portable project build
patch:
--- .github/workflows/passive-rdp-monitor-1772-files.yml
@@ -28,7 +28,7 @@ jobs:
 
       - name: Build portable x64
         shell: pwsh
-        run: msbuild .\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG.csproj /m /p:Configuration="Release Portable" /p:Platform="x64" /verbosity:minimal
+        run: msbuild .\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG.csproj /m /p:Configuration="Release Portable" /p:Platform="x64" /p:SolutionDir="$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\" /verbosity:minimal
 
       - name: Prepare artifact directory
         shell: pwsh

security_flags.reason: CI workflow changes are the primary supply-chain vector (pull_request_target abuse, workflow injection)

triage.rationale: Modifies a custom GitHub workflow file (`passive-rdp-monitor-1772-files.yml`) that is completely absent from our fork.
